entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Oh, hello. Yes, I hope so. I'm trying to figure out a return, and the website is just... so much. I'm a bit lost.
I can definitely help you with that. Can I start with your name and order number, please?
Sure. It's Alex Chen, order number 788-1452. I'm just not sure what the rules are. It's all very confusing.
Thank you, Alex. I see your order for the Pro-Level cycling shoes. To get started, can you tell me what specifically is the issue with them?

Well, I finally got around to setting them up with the cleats and trying them on a ride, but they're just awful. They gave me terrible blisters on my heels. They just don't fit my feet at all. Can't you just help me? I don't know what to do.
I'm very sorry to hear they're causing you blisters, Alex. That's definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just take a look at your order details and our policy for you.
Okay. I know I've had them for a little while. Is that going to be a problem?
Let's see... it looks like the delivery was 83 days ago. But that's no problem at all. For standard items like these cycling shoes, our return policy is 90 days.
Oh, really? So it's okay? I can still get a refund?
Yes, absolutely. You are well within the window, so I can go ahead and process this return for a full refund for you right now.
Wow, that's such a relief. I was so worried I was stuck with them. Thank you. So... what happens next?

I've just initiated the return and sent a pre-paid shipping label to the email address on your account. You just need to print it, attach it to the box, and you can drop it off. Once our warehouse receives it, your refund will be processed.
Okay... a label to my email. I think I can handle that. Thank you so much for making that so simple.
You are very welcome, Alex. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
